generator.description:
Fixed nonlinear PCRL pilot: protection-aware upstream training before LEACE.

L=(U,V,S,E1,...,E5) ~ N(0,I8); X=(LQ1 + .2*(LQ1)^3)Q2+b.
The two fixed orthogonal matrices and the monotone componentwise cubic make
the observation map invertible. No generator parameter depends on outcomes.

configuration.selection: Within each new method: require both validation MLP task R2 >= .99; then minimize maximum of all 10 leakage/threshold ratios; tie by higher minimum purpose utility then key. If no utility-feasible candidate, diagnostic only: highest minimum purpose utility then lowest ratio then key.
